Oral Health Assessment
Oral health assessment is integral to the nutritional status of older adults. Factors that can contrib­
ute to oral health problems include tooth decay, ill-fitting dentures, endentulism, pain, disease 
states, and medications which may alter taste. There is a strong connection between oral health 
and a person’s general health status. An association has been noted between periodontal disease 
and myocardial infarction. It has also been reported that endentulous older adults consume fewer 
servings of fruits and vegetables and more soft foods, often leading to decreased fiber intake. There
